*Basic effect(s)*
- "Corroded Body and Mind" Category or INT Type allies' Ki +3 and

same turn*
- Changes Ki Spheres: INT to STR
- ATK & DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of evading enemy's attack & damage reduction rate 20%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Guards all attacks
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
*As the 3rd attacker in a turn, or for 1 turn from the character's entry
turn*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- High chance of evading enemy's attack
- "Corroded Body and Mind" Category allies' ATK 20%{passiveImg:up_g}
- ATK 30%{passiveImg:up_g} and chance of performing a critical hit 10%{passiveImg:up_g} for
allies whose names include "Baby" or "Possessed"
